mapper.sql: ID, DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME, TOURISM_NAME, COUNT, DENSITY, ALG_NAME, TASK_CODE, IMAGE_URL, RECORD_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 2) as avgDensity, MAX(DENSITY) as maxDensity, MIN(DENSITY) as minDensity FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT TO_CHAR(RECORD_TIME, 'HH24') as hour, ROUND(AVG(COUNT), 2) as count, ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 2) as density FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} AND RECORD_TIME BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(RECORD_TIME, 'HH24') ORDER BY hour
